title: vm-start
description: Receipt for `testanyware vm start`. Identifies the started VM and its endpoints.

dry_run.description: Present and true when --dry-run was set.

id.description: VM instance id. Defaults to testanyware-<hex8>; a caller-supplied --id may use any value.

base.description: Golden image cloned for this VM.

agent.description: Agent endpoint, or null if the agent did not reach health within the boot window.

tpm.description: The TPM decision this start was made under (ADR-0017). Present for QEMU-backed starts and under --dry-run; absent for tart-backed (macOS, tart Linux) starts, which have no such decision.

attached.description: true when the guest got a TPM (swtpm and a tpm-tis-device); false when it was omitted.

ppi_off.description: Present when attached. true when the device was wired with ppi=off (HVF with a QEMU that lists a ppi property).

reason.description: Present when omitted. guest_does_not_need_one: only Windows needs a TPM. host_cannot_supply_one: the host's QEMU binary has no tpm-tis-device.
